M-INIT.NAME: Project bootstrap
M-INIT.purpose: Bootstrap a MyGRACE project from bundled templates: docs/ structure, AGENTS.md and mygrace.config.json (ADR-5).

fn-buildSpecs.PURPOSE: Template to destination mapping (docs indexes, AGENTS.md).

fn-ensureGitignore.PURPOSE: Create .gitignore with .mygrace/ (or note it) so the trust record is never committed.

export-initDshCommand.PURPOSE: init-dsh command with --path/--name/--force and runtime options.

contract.purpose: Bootstrap a MyGRACE project from bundled templates: docs/ structure, AGENTS.md and mygrace.config.json (ADR-5).

error.description: Bundled templates directory is absent in an incomplete package.

notes.note-1: Never overwrites existing files without --force; the repository AGENTS.md is preserved by design.
notes.note-2: Generated scaffold is lint-clean; scripts/pack-smoke.ts verifies this end-to-end on the packaged CLI.
notes.note-4: Also ensures .mygrace/ is gitignored (ADR-1); an existing .gitignore is never rewritten, only annotated.
notes.note-3: The interactive, question-driven bootstrap remains the mygrace-init skill.
